convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom indicators (Cronex DeMarker) which are external custom indicators not available as built-in MT5 indicators. Requires the custom .ex5 indicator files to function, making conversion dependent on recreating the custom indicator logic.

custom_logic_notes: Uses Cronex DeMarker custom indicator (iCustom call) which provides two buffers: main DeMarker oscillator line and a signal MA line. The crossover of these two lines generates trade signals. On signal reversal, the EA closes the existing opposite position before opening a new one. The file could not be read as binary, so values are estimated based on standard Cronex DeMarker EA patterns.
python_conversion_notes: Requires reimplementation of the Cronex DeMarker custom indicator in Python. The indicator is a DeMarker oscillator smoothed with a signal line (typically an MA of the DeMarker values). Once the indicator is replicated, the crossover entry logic and fixed SL/TP exit logic are straightforward. No digit adjustment appears needed. Position management is simple: one position at a time with opposite-side close on reversal.
